members.name: banking77_e7_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which single intent best describes what the customer wants help with?

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card the customer has received: how to activate it, activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using or adding the card to Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets; top up via Apple/Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Which or where ATMs can be used with the card; finding an ATM; whether the card works at a given ATM.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, turning it off, whether it exists. Examples: "What, if any, is the limit  for auto top-up?"
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money transferred in from a bank account (or a transfer made) but the balance has not updated / money not showing yet; asking to check that a recent transfer into the account went through. Examples: "Can you please check my UK Account to make sure everything went alright?  I made the transfer a couple of hours ago."
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit made but the balance has not updated / deposit not showing. Examples: "My cheque is slow to cash" | "I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?"
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary, beneficiary not allowed or rejected; trouble sending money to a beneficiary. Examples: "I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery."
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a bank transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account, changed mind). Not for purchases.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired: getting a replacement, what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: whether shops/merchants/countries accept the card, card not accepted somewhere.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card still not received.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when a new card will arrive; express delivery options (asked before it is late).
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account/app: adding or re-linking a found or existing card in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card does not work at all / stopped working / is broken or damaged; something is wrong with my card, it never goes through after many tries (not specific to contactless or ATMs). Examples: "There is something wrong with my card. Tried to use it a few times today in different places and it just didn't work. The transactions I tried to make were really small so not sure what's going on" | "What's going on with my card? I've tried multiple times and it never goes through."
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: An extra fee applied to a card payment/purchase; why was I charged a fee for using my card; when do you charge fees. Examples: "I am tired of getting charged fees, and I have no idea why, please let me know what/when you charge fees for."
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/transaction on the statement the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Card payment abroad or in foreign currency charged at a wrong or bad exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; why was I charged for a withdrawal; ATM fees. Examples: "I got charged a fee that shouldn't be there from my cash"
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make, or the app shows cash taken out that they never received. Not for an ATM giving less cash than requested (that is wrong_amount_of_cash_received). Examples: "My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive."
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the PIN (not blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised/hacked/leaked, fraud concerns about the card itself; someone else may have their card details.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless / tap to pay does not work.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in; using or opening the account from a given country; living abroad. Examples: "Can I get support?"
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM declined or refused the cash withdrawal; could not get cash out. Examples: "My card wont work at an ATM"
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or not allowed to go through. Examples: "I have tried a couple of times to make a purchase and my card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfers? I have already tried a couple of times and it's not working."
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit, or an unknown/unexplained charge on the account or debit statement (not described as a card payment), that the customer does not recognise or did not set up. Not for questions about fees. Examples: "i do not know what this charge is for" | "I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement." | "I have an unknown charge." | "My accounts been charged a payment for something I didn't make."
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many can I create.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currencies; extra charges when exchanging; discounts on exchange costs for frequent exchanges. Examples: "If I exchange currency frequently, can I get a discounted rate?"
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used; how exchange rates are calculated; current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange / convert money between currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra small charge on the statement (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 charge), unexpected charge that is not a card/ATM/transfer fee.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer or large payment (e.g. mortgage, buying a flat) failed, keeps being unsuccessful or shows an error; did not go through / was returned. Examples: "I have tried 5 times at this point to complete a transfer that's simply standard. What appears to be the problem? Is your system messed up?" | "Hi, I'm in progress of purchasing a flat and am trying to make to make a payment.  An error is appearing, and I need assistance."
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange; whether a particular currency is supported; which currencies you support in general (not specifically about adding money / top-ups). Examples: "Tell me the currencies that you support."
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card in hand, e.g. where to find the PIN for the new physical card; can I get a physical card. Examples: "how do i get a pin for my card"
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare/another card for the account or for someone else; how many cards I can have. Examples: "How do I go about ordering another card?"
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card; whether virtual cards are available.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost or stolen; what to do; freezing or blocking the card urgently. Examples: "Can you provide information for freezing my card immediately?"
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost or stolen; access to the app/account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order a physical card; ordering a new card; delivery address/country options when ordering.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; locked out of the app; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet; waiting for a payment to complete. Examples: "I was wondering why my payment hasn't gone through yet, its been a while."
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still showing as pending / in progress; money not received yet while the transaction is still in progress. Examples: "I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress. Can you fix it?"
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending / not yet completed.
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is pending / still in progress; how long it stays pending. Examples: "How long do you expect me to wait for the transfer? It finally worked out, but has been pending for a long time and it's quite urgent." | "It seems like I have been waiting forever for this international transfer. Why is it taking so long? C'mon, it's 2018, things happen at a click of a button. All of the account information is correct, so how long will this take?"
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock the PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from other people or employers into the account (e.g. salary, payments from others). Examples: "Can my friend send me money if it is not in US dollars?" | "Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?" | "Do I need to add my salary?"
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared on the account.
criteria.request_refund: How to request a refund for a purchase / get money back from a merchant; cancelling a purchase I no longer want. Examples: "I no longer want this can i cancel my purchase?"
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/Amex etc.), payment methods and currencies are accepted specifically when adding money / topping up. Examples: "Am I able to add money into my account using my American Express?" | "I am adding money, what currencies do you accept to do this?" | "What currencies can I use?" | "I want to add funds to my account. What payment methods are accepted?"
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up or adding money by bank transfer, including SWIFT / international bank transfers into the account. Examples: "I want to do a swift transfer"
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up using a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; depositing cash/cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined. Examples: "I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly."
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum amounts, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted/cancelled/money taken back after top-up. Examples: "Hello,  I have recharged topup but account is not credited. Please help me in this, i guess there is some defect in system."
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up the account (with a card); card top-up process; whether others can top up my account; card top-up money disappeared. Examples: "Can other people top up my account?" | "The money disappeared when I tried to use my card to top up."
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer or for sending money / banking abroad; I thought transfers were free. Examples: "This isn't fair! I thought transfers could be made for free. I just made  a purchase online from abroad and now see some strange fee that I've never seen before." | "Could you inform me as to why I have been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad."
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer. Examples: "My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?"
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Money the customer sent has not arrived / the transfer or transaction is taking too long to complete or reach the recipient. Examples: "Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?"
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes to arrive; when will transferred money arrive.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Having trouble verifying identity; verification failing or not possible.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or proving the source of funds / where money comes from. Examples: "How can I find out where the funds are flow?"
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification of a top-up card; verifying a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work / was declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them. Examples: "Please help me get a Visa card."
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required; whether I have to verify; can I use the account without verifying. Examples: "Can I use my account without verifying identity?" | "Do i have to verify who I am?"
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested, while the account was debited the full amount.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad. Examples: "Why is the exchange rate so high? This should have been a much higher amount of cash for that to apply."

criteria.activate_my_card: Use when the customer's main concern is: activating a card the customer has received: how to activate it, activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Use when the customer's main concern is: minimum age to open an account or use the service; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Use when the customer's main concern is: using or adding the card to Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets; top up via Apple/Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Use when the customer's main concern is: which or where ATMs can be used with the card; finding an ATM; whether the card works at a given ATM.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Messages like "What, if any, is the limit  for auto top-up?". Use when the customer's main concern is: auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works, turning it off, whether it exists.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Messages like "Can you please check my UK Account to make sure everything went alright?  I made the transfer a couple of hours ago.". Use when the customer's main concern is: money transferred in from a bank account (or a transfer made) but the balance has not updated / money not showing yet; asking to check that a recent transfer into the account went through.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Messages like "My cheque is slow to cash" | "I recently deposited some money into my account, but it still isn't showing up. What's going on?". Use when the customer's main concern is: a cheque or cash deposit made but the balance has not updated / deposit not showing.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Messages like "I am having trouble transferring money to a beneficiery.". Use when the customer's main concern is: cannot add a payee/beneficiary, beneficiary not allowed or rejected; trouble sending money to a beneficiary.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Use when the customer's main concern is: wants to cancel or reverse a bank transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account, changed mind). Not for purchases.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Use when the customer's main concern is: card is expiring or expired: getting a replacement, what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Use when the customer's main concern is: where the card is accepted: whether shops/merchants/countries accept the card, card not accepted somewhere.
criteria.card_arrival: Use when the customer's main concern is: ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card still not received.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Use when the customer's main concern is: how long card delivery takes; when a new card will arrive; express delivery options (asked before it is late).
criteria.card_linking: Use when the customer's main concern is: linking a card to the account/app: adding or re-linking a found or existing card in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Messages like "There is something wrong with my card. Tried to use it a few times today in different places and it just didn't work. The transactions I tried to make were really small so not sure what's going on" | "What's going on with my card? I've tried multiple times and it never goes through.". Use when the customer's main concern is: the physical card does not work at all / stopped working / is broken or damaged; something is wrong with my card, it never goes through after many tries (not specific to contactless or ATMs).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Messages like "I am tired of getting charged fees, and I have no idea why, please let me know what/when you charge fees for.". Use when the customer's main concern is: an extra fee applied to a card payment/purchase; why was I charged a fee for using my card; when do you charge fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Use when the customer's main concern is: a card payment/transaction on the statement the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Use when the customer's main concern is: card payment abroad or in foreign currency charged at a wrong or bad exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: Use when the customer's main concern is: an ATM kept, ate or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Messages like "I got charged a fee that shouldn't be there from my cash". Use when the customer's main concern is: fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; why was I charged for a withdrawal; ATM fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Messages like "My app is showing a cash balance that I did not receive.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make, or the app shows cash taken out that they never received. Not for an ATM giving less cash than requested (that is wrong_amount_of_cash_received).
criteria.change_pin: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to change or reset the PIN (not blocked).
criteria.compromised_card: Use when the customer's main concern is: card details may be compromised/hacked/leaked, fraud concerns about the card itself; someone else may have their card details.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Use when the customer's main concern is: contactless / tap to pay does not work.
criteria.country_support: Messages like "Can I get support?". Use when the customer's main concern is: which countries the service is available in; using or opening the account from a given country; living abroad.
criteria.declined_card_payment: Use when the customer's main concern is: a card payment was declined or rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Messages like "My card wont work at an ATM". Use when the customer's main concern is: the ATM declined or refused the cash withdrawal; could not get cash out.
criteria.declined_transfer: Messages like "I have tried a couple of times to make a purchase and my card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfers? I have already tried a couple of times and it's not working.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a transfer was declined or not allowed to go through.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Messages like "i do not know what this charge is for" | "I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement." | "I have an unknown charge." | "My accounts been charged a payment for something I didn't make.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a direct debit, or an unknown/unexplained charge on the account or debit statement (not described as a card payment), that the customer does not recognise or did not set up. Not for questions about fees.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Use when the customer's main concern is: limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many can I create.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Use when the customer's main concern is: changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Messages like "If I exchange currency frequently, can I get a discounted rate?". Use when the customer's main concern is: fees or charges for exchanging currencies; extra charges when exchanging; discounts on exchange costs for frequent exchanges.
criteria.exchange_rate: Use when the customer's main concern is: what exchange rate is used; how exchange rates are calculated; current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to exchange / convert money between currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Use when the customer's main concern is: an unexplained extra small charge on the statement (e.g. an extra £1 / $1 charge), unexpected charge that is not a card/ATM/transfer fee.
criteria.failed_transfer: Messages like "I have tried 5 times at this point to complete a transfer that's simply standard. What appears to be the problem? Is your system messed up?" | "Hi, I'm in progress of purchasing a flat and am trying to make to make a payment.  An error is appearing, and I need assistance.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a transfer or large payment (e.g. mortgage, buying a flat) failed, keeps being unsuccessful or shows an error; did not go through / was returned.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Messages like "Tell me the currencies that you support.". Use when the customer's main concern is: which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange; whether a particular currency is supported; which currencies you support in general (not specifically about adding money / top-ups).
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Messages like "how do i get a pin for my card". Use when the customer's main concern is: getting a physical card in hand, e.g. where to find the PIN for the new physical card; can I get a physical card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Messages like "How do I go about ordering another card?". Use when the customer's main concern is: getting an additional/extra/spare/another card for the account or for someone else; how many cards I can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card; whether virtual cards are available.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Messages like "Can you provide information for freezing my card immediately?". Use when the customer's main concern is: card is lost or stolen; what to do; freezing or blocking the card urgently.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Use when the customer's main concern is: phone was lost or stolen; access to the app/account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to order a physical card; ordering a new card; delivery address/country options when ordering.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Use when the customer's main concern is: forgot the app passcode/password; locked out of the app; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: Messages like "I was wondering why my payment hasn't gone through yet, its been a while.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet; waiting for a payment to complete.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Messages like "I didn't receive my money earlier and it says the transaction is still in progress. Can you fix it?". Use when the customer's main concern is: a cash withdrawal is still showing as pending / in progress; money not received yet while the transaction is still in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: Use when the customer's main concern is: a top-up is still pending / not yet completed.
criteria.pending_transfer: Messages like "How long do you expect me to wait for the transfer? It finally worked out, but has been pending for a long time and it's quite urgent." | "It seems like I have been waiting forever for this international transfer. Why is it taking so long? C'mon, it's 2018, things happen at a click of a button. All of the account information is correct, so how long will this take?". Use when the customer's main concern is: an outgoing transfer is pending / still in progress; how long it stays pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: Use when the customer's main concern is: pIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock the PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: Messages like "Can my friend send me money if it is not in US dollars?" | "Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?" | "Do I need to add my salary?". Use when the customer's main concern is: receiving money from other people or employers into the account (e.g. salary, payments from others).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Use when the customer's main concern is: a refund from a merchant has not appeared on the account.
criteria.request_refund: Messages like "I no longer want this can i cancel my purchase?". Use when the customer's main concern is: how to request a refund for a purchase / get money back from a merchant; cancelling a purchase I no longer want.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Use when the customer's main concern is: a card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Messages like "Am I able to add money into my account using my American Express?" | "I am adding money, what currencies do you accept to do this?" | "What currencies can I use?" | "I want to add funds to my account. What payment methods are accepted?". Use when the customer's main concern is: which cards (Visa/Mastercard/Amex etc.), payment methods and currencies are accepted specifically when adding money / topping up.
criteria.terminate_account: Use when the customer's main concern is: close or delete the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Messages like "I want to do a swift transfer". Use when the customer's main concern is: fees for topping up or adding money by bank transfer, including SWIFT / international bank transfers into the account.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Use when the customer's main concern is: fees for topping up using a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Use when the customer's main concern is: topping up with cash or a cheque; depositing cash/cheques.
criteria.top_up_failed: Messages like "I can't access my money. Is it because somethings wrong with the top-up? I set it up correctly.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a top-up failed or was declined.
criteria.top_up_limits: Use when the customer's main concern is: limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum amounts, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: Messages like "Hello,  I have recharged topup but account is not credited. Please help me in this, i guess there is some defect in system.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a top-up was reverted/cancelled/money taken back after top-up.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Messages like "Can other people top up my account?" | "The money disappeared when I tried to use my card to top up.". Use when the customer's main concern is: how to top up the account (with a card); card top-up process; whether others can top up my account; card top-up money disappeared.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Use when the customer's main concern is: the same payment was charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Messages like "This isn't fair! I thought transfers could be made for free. I just made  a purchase online from abroad and now see some strange fee that I've never seen before." | "Could you inform me as to why I have been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad.". Use when the customer's main concern is: a fee was charged for a transfer or for sending money / banking abroad; I thought transfers were free.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Messages like "My money is all gone. What ways are okay to add money to my account?". Use when the customer's main concern is: how to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Messages like "Why is my transaction taking so long to complete?". Use when the customer's main concern is: money the customer sent has not arrived / the transfer or transaction is taking too long to complete or reach the recipient.
criteria.transfer_timing: Use when the customer's main concern is: how long a transfer takes to arrive; when will transferred money arrive.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Use when the customer's main concern is: having trouble verifying identity; verification failing or not possible.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Use when the customer's main concern is: how to verify identity; what documents are needed for verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Messages like "How can I find out where the funds are flow?". Use when the customer's main concern is: verifying or proving the source of funds / where money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Use when the customer's main concern is: verification code or verification of a top-up card; verifying a top-up.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Use when the customer's main concern is: the virtual card does not work / was declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Messages like "Please help me get a Visa card.". Use when the customer's main concern is: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Messages like "Can I use my account without verifying identity?" | "Do i have to verify who I am?". Use when the customer's main concern is: why identity verification is required; whether I have to verify; can I use the account without verifying.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Use when the customer's main concern is: aTM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested, while the account was debited the full amount.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Messages like "Why is the exchange rate so high? This should have been a much higher amount of cash for that to apply.". Use when the customer's main concern is: wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal abroad.
